end.parentNote: Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere using toys and everyday objects. Aditya used curved-side and flat-face clues for a cylinder, and identified a ball as a sphere. They mixed up cubes and cuboids, and thought turning a cone changes its name; these points were not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to check whether all faces are equal squares before calling a box a cube, and turn objects around while keeping the same shape name.
